alt: A museum replica of the 18th-century Mechanical Turk chess automaton — a wooden cabinet with a mechanical arm and a mannequin in Ottoman dress, the famous hoax that concealed a human chess master inside the machine
story: Amazon announced on August 26, 2026 that it's shutting down Mechanical Turk (MTurk) on September 30 — the platform Jeff Bezos called 'artificial artificial intelligence' because it used human workers to perform tasks too hard for real AI; after 21 years of humans training AI, the AI got good enough to replace them.
why_funny: The platform was literally named after an 18th-century chess automaton that hid a human grandmaster inside a fake robot — and now the fake AI has been defeated by the real thing it spent two decades helping build.
